prompts.name: hero
prompts.prompt: Stylized concept art asset for professional fitness app. Wide 16:9 hero. Premium 3D athletic mannequin wearing a complete opaque dark navy fitted training shirt and fitted leggings. Subject on right half, dark navy empty space left for interface text added separately. Dark studio background #17212D, soft rim lighting, photorealistic 3D product rendering, restrained elegant sculptural fitness visual. No lettering, logos, interface, badges, hologram rings or game elements.
